# Northern Italy Journey

※ This file is a plain-text sample for the Itinerary module.
※ In [Plan - Itinerary], choose Import Document to auto-fill; supports .txt / .md / .docx.
※ Format notes:
※   Line 1: hash + space + trip title, shown in the import success message only.
※   Day line: Day + number + colon + date, e.g. Day 1: 2026-09-16.
※   Daily theme line: two hashes + space + theme, right after the day line.
※   Timeline card: bracketed 24-hour time + space + card title, following lines become description.
※   Untimed cards: bracketed tag [Itinerary] / [Strategy] / [Notes] / [Tips] + space + title.
※   Three dashes on their own line separate days.

Day 1: 2026-09-16
## Arrival in Milan, Gothic Grandeur
[10:35] Land at Milan Malpensa Airport (MXP)
Take the Malpensa Express directly to Milano Centrale, approx. 52 minutes. Tickets can be purchased at airport kiosks.
[13:30] Hotel Check-in & Midday Rest
[15:30] Duomo di Milano
Gothic masterpiece: climb to the rooftop terraces to take in Milan's spire forest, with marble glowing gold at dusk.
[18:30] Galleria Vittorio Emanuele II & Dinner
Window shopping under the grand iron-and-glass dome; enjoy traditional Milanese saffron risotto nearby.
[Notes] Transportation Tips
The airport express terminates at Milano Centrale; transfer to Metro M3 (Yellow Line) to reach Duomo station.

---

Day 2: 2026-09-17
## Milan Morning & Renaissance Treasures
[08:00] Breakfast at Marchesi 1824
Historic 200-year-old pastry shop; wake up Milan's morning with a pistachio croissant and rich hot chocolate.
[09:30] The Last Supper at Santa Maria delle Grazie
Leonardo da Vinci's genuine masterpiece; reservation required weeks in advance, 15-minute slot per group.
[13:00] Sforza Castle & Sempione Park
Free access to castle courtyards; afternoon stroll through Sempione Park towards the Arco della Pace.
[19:00] Dinner in Navigli Canal District
Birthplace of Milan's iconic Aperitivo culture; evening walk along the scenic canal banks after dinner.

---

Day 3: 2026-09-18
## Farewell Milan, Bound for the Renaissance Heart
[08:30] Depart from Milano Centrale
Board the Frecciarossa high-speed train south to Florence Santa Maria Novella station, approx. 1h 50m.
[11:00] Arrive in Florence & Store Luggage
[14:00] Galleria dell'Accademia
Michelangelo's original David and the Prisoners series, celebrating the pinnacle of Renaissance sculpture.
[17:00] Florence Cathedral (Cattedrale di Santa Maria del Fiore)
Brunelleschi's magnificent brick dome and Vasari's Last Judgment fresco, illuminated beautifully at dusk.
[Strategy] Ticket Booking Strategy
Online timed-entry tickets are strongly recommended for Accademia and the Dome climb to skip 1-hour queues.
